div.div:
1 Accounts
Role, User and everything that belongs to one user.
Follow points to User twice: who follows (FollowerID) and who is followed (FollowedID).
UserCategory = the crafts a user picked in join step 2.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
2 Posts
A post, its images (cover + step photos), its categories and its tags.
Grey boxes are the same tables as on other pages
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
3 Likes and comments
Comments (a reply points to its parent comment in the same table), post likes and comment likes. A like row = one user liked one post or comment.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
4 Boards
A board belongs to one user.
BoardPost = which posts are on a board.
UserSavedBoard = which boards a user saved.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
5 Challenges
The admin who sets up a challenge (SetUpByUserID) and the members who join it. Posts can point to a challenge too (see page 2, Post.ChallengeID).
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
6 Reports
A report is about exactly ONE thing: a post OR a comment OR a user (the other two stay empty).
ReporterID = who reported.
HandlerID = the admin who handled it (empty until then). The database checks the exactly-one rule.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

div.div:
7 Notifications
A notification goes to a recipient (who gets it) and names the actor (who did it). It points to a post and/or a comment. Only for comments, replies and new followers. Never for likes.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table.
Blue = junction or extra table.
Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.

8 Site
These two tables stand alone. SiteSetting has ONE row (the admin edits it). FaqItem = one row per question and answer.
Arrow = from the PK (primary key) to the FK (foreign key) that points to it.
Dashed arrow = the FK may be empty (NULL).
Purple = main table. Blue = junction or extra table. Grey = shortened copy of a table from another page.
